purpose: Table of contents derived from the body headings.

variants.hover: Fixed left list that expands labels on hover (blog post, 1200px+).
variants.tick: Fixed left tick rail with hover popover (guide, 1200px+).
variants.inline: 'In this guide' disclosure above the body (guide, below 1200px).

responsive.detail: hover/tick shown from 1200px; inline shown below 1200px.

notes: A guide page carries two TOC nodes (inline + tick); rules key on (section, variant).
